# Get to know yourself

Get to know yourself

Your personality may make you more suited for some jobs than others.

[Know Yourself Profiling Tools: for secondary school studentsDiscover your personality and use it to plan your education or career.](https://www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg/content/student/en/secondary/assessment.html)[Know Yourself Profiling Tools: for pre-university studentsDiscover your personality and use it to plan your education or career.](https://www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg/content/student/en/preu/assessment.html)[RIASEC Profiling Tools: for adults or polytechnic and ITE studentsDiscover your career interests, skills confidence, and work values—and use them to identify suitable careers.](https://www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg/content/portal/en/assessment/landing.html)

Discover possible careers

Get a clearer idea of what you may want to do by reading about industries and roles.

[Singapore industry landscapeGet facts and figures and explore available roles based on industry.](https://www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg/content/student/en/preu/world-of-work/industry-landscape.html)

Choose your educational path

Which academic qualifications do you need for the career you want?

[Singapore education landscapeWhat happens after secondary school? Explore available paths based on your interests, strengths, and learning style.](https://www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg/content/student/en/secondary/education-guide/education-landscape.html)[SchoolFinderExplore schools based on their distance from your home, locations, CCAs, subjects and programmes offered.](https://www.moe.gov.sg/schoolfinder)[CourseFinderExplore courses based on aggregate type, score, type of institute and area of interest.](https://www.moe.gov.sg/coursefinder)

Gain real-world insights

Stay connected to the working world through resources and internships.

[OMW! Network Connects: a Telegram channelBite-sized education & career resources from National Youth Council.](https://t.me/OMWNetworkConnects)[Careers@Gov internshipsSearch and apply for an internship position with public agencies.](https://www.careers.hrp.gov.sg/sap/bc/ui5_ui5/sap/ZGERCFA004/index.html)

You may also be interested in...

[Support for your job search](https://www.life.gov.sg/guides/support-for-your-job-search)

metadata.title: Get to know yourself
metadata.description: Figuring out what to study or what career you should pursue is not an easy decision. Start by understanding yourself and your options.
